title: Estimate Order
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 16; 0 \leq M \leq \frac{N(N - 1)}{2}; 1 \leq A_i, B_i \leq N; 1 \leq C_i \leq N - 1; (A_i, B_i) \neq (A_j, B_j) (i \neq j); There is at least one possible ranking that does not contradict the given information.; All input values are integers.
